Facet — 第三方许可证与声明 / Third-party licenses and notices

本文件列出 Windows 发行版涉及的第三方组件及许可原文。许可只适用于所列第三方材料，不授予 Facet 自有代码的许可。
This file identifies third-party material used by the Windows distribution. The listed licenses apply to that material, not to Facet-owned code.
此清单按生产依赖保守汇总；打包或链接时可能剔除未使用的代码。构建工具本身与实际随安装器分发的代码分开处理。
Conservative Windows production dependency inventory; unused code may be removed by the bundler or linker. Build-only/proc-macro dependencies are excluded. Additional fonts, assets, standard-library and installer notices are reviewed separately.

目录 / Contents
1. 组件、版本与来源 / Components, versions and sources
2. 完整许可与版权声明 / Full license and copyright texts

1. 组件、版本与来源 / Components, versions and sources

Blue Obelisk compiled van der Waals radii c22a20077698
  Category: assets
  License: CC0-1.0
  Source: https://github.com/BlueObelisk/bodr/tree/c22a200776984388564ef90536d8af24ae09d21e
  Note: 13 lanthanide values match bo:radiusVDW in elements.xml. These are identified as compiled references, not universally measured radii. Contributors: Geoffrey R. Hutchison, Carsten Niehaus, Egon Willighagen and Bert de Jong. COPYING/README and the 2013-08-02 relicensing commit 9a2e5ea17b1ef4c303ce4eab902740bff5aa0157 specify CC0; elements.xml retains stale MIT metadata. No BODR software runtime is included.
  Full texts: [34]

ColorBrewer BrBG color specifications 7d135fc4e19e
  Category: assets
  License: Apache-2.0; original ColorBrewer notices retained
  Source: https://github.com/axismaps/colorbrewer/tree/7d135fc4e19eda73f2eb1bf55fcdf4a04fe4881f
  Note: This product includes color specifications and designs developed by Cynthia Brewer (http://colorbrewer.org/). Facet combines the BrBG 3-color sequence with the two endpoints of its 11-color sequence, then interpolates between the five stops. This is an adaptation, not the original ColorBrewer 5-class palette.
  Full texts: [32], [94]

Facet UI Sans / Source Han Sans CN 2.005 (GB2312 subset)
  Category: assets
  License: OFL-1.1
  Source: https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-han-sans/tree/2.005R
  Note: Renamed and subset for Facet; see the included modification notice. The font binary is unchanged by this license inventory.
  Full texts: [186], [19]

Jmol legacy element colors (data only) 12.1.15 / revision 14469
  Category: assets
  License: LGPL-2.1-or-later
  Source: https://svn.code.sf.net/p/jmol/code/trunk/Jmol/src/org/jmol/viewer/JmolConstants.java?p=14469
  Note: Conservative provenance notice for legacy color values: 30 Jmol-palette entries and 23 of the 25 newVESTA materialStudio entries match the official Jmol color table. Facet stores hexadecimal color values; no Jmol Java or JSmol runtime is included. This notice records upstream terms and does not declare Facet-owned code to be LGPL. Historical acquisition and redistribution requirements remain part of the data-provenance review.
  Full texts: [135], [43]

Matplotlib scientific colormap data 3.10.7
  Category: assets
  License: Matplotlib
  Source: https://github.com/matplotlib/matplotlib/tree/v3.10.7
  Note: Facet extracts the magma, inferno, plasma, viridis, cividis and turbo 256-color tables and stores RGB nodes in TypeScript. No Matplotlib Python runtime is included. Copyright (c) 2012- Matplotlib Development Team; All Rights Reserved.
  Full texts: [69]

NIST neutral-atom reference data (H–Hs) reviewed 2026-11-08
  Category: assets
  License: NIST non-SRD data terms
  Source: https://www.nist.gov/pml/periodic-table-elements
  Note: Alexander Kramida, Karen Olsen and Yuri Ralchenko, NIST Periodic Table of the Elements / Elemental Data Index. The periodic table is classified as an information compilation, formerly SRD 145. Facet independently checks the H–Hs occupations; Lr uses 5f14 7s2 7p1. Modification, 2026-11-08: noble-gas cores are omitted, occupations are reordered and filtered by the existing display convention. Reference data are not all experimental measurements. Full NIST non-SRD terms are retained.
  Full texts: [79]

Smits et al. superheavy-atom theoretical configurations 2023, Table 2
  Category: assets
  License: CC-BY-4.0
  Source: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.physrep.2023.09.004
  Note: Mt–Og dominant theoretical configurations, reduced to ordinary subshell occupations. NIST is used for Lr; the different Lr entry in this paper is not adopted. Attribution and the dated adaptation description accompany the full license.

[19]
Applies to: Facet UI Sans / Source Han Sans CN 2.005 (GB2312 subset)
Source: Facet font modification notice

Facet UI Sans — GB2312 font subset

Contents
1. Origin and license
2. Character and weight coverage
3. Updating the subset

1. Origin and license
This modified font is derived from Adobe Source Han Sans CN Variable 2.005.
Copyright 2014–2025 Adobe. The upstream Reserved Font Name is “Source”.
The modified font's primary family name is Facet UI Sans.
It is distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; see LICENSE.txt.
The original copyright and license metadata are retained in the font.

2. Character and weight coverage
Includes all 6,763 GB2312 Han characters, supported characters in Facet's
current Simplified Chinese and US English catalogs, and the supported
characters in the extra Unicode ranges listed in subset-manifest.json.
Retains the full variable weight range 250–900 and OpenType layout features.
Characters outside this subset use Facet's existing system-font fallbacks.
The independent scientific/PDF export fonts are not replaced by this resource.

3. Updating the subset
Regenerate when the bilingual catalogs introduce new characters.
The source fingerprint, catalog hashes, Unicode ranges and generator command
are recorded in subset-manifest.json. The release maintenance directory holds
the original font backup and the reproducible generator; do not put the full
original font back under public/, as all public assets are packaged.

中文说明
本字体由 Adobe 思源黑体简中可变字体 2.005 裁剪而来，内部名称改为 Facet UI Sans。
保留 GB2312 的 6,763 个汉字、当前中英文词典及所列范围内原字体支持的符号，
保留 250–900 完整可变字重。字库外字符使用既有系统备用字体。
许可和原版权信息保留；详见 LICENSE.txt。增加新界面字符后需要同步重建子集。

a de-facto standard.  To achieve this, non-free programs must be
allowed to use the library.  A more frequent case is that a free
library does the same job as widely used non-free libraries.  In this
case, there is little to gain by limiting the free library to free
software only, so we use the Lesser General Public License.
